_: Real bugs the regression suite has found and that are not fixed yet. Each entry: the test (tests/<test>.js), the case or problem text it matches, and the bug. A check that matches an entry is reported KNOWN (not a failure); an entry that no longer matches anything is reported, so it can be taken off once the bug is fixed. The suite never fixes the game itself.

known.bug: Karna's-day duel fights (kd_e_son, kd_e_wheel) on the war-day screen on an upright phone ask for art/scene_duel_ground_tall.webp, which does not exist: a 404 and no painted ground behind the fighters.
known.file: game/js/content/war_duel.js:98 (K.COMMAND_FIGHT_BG -> scene_duel_ground, painted only 16:9), read by game/js/ui/warday.js:129,169

A Kaurava life on day 17, choose 'Guard Vrishasena's wheel' (kd_e_son) or the wheel fight (kd_e_wheel) on an iPhone held upright: the stage's background-image is art/scene_duel_ground_tall.webp and the request 404s.

known.bug: Not a game bug: test sampling. tests/command.js fails when one of the four holding-fight offers is never met in its lives; they are rare (0-7 in 120 lives) and which one is missed moves with every balance change (60 lives on 3e2854d missed hold_bhima_offer; 120 lives on cd454b0 missed hold_arjuna_offer). tests/content.js shows all four reachable. More lives would settle it, but jsdom keeps about 25 MB per finished life and 200 lives run out of memory.
